seoTitle: Hawaii Public Schools Calendar 2028-2029: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the Hawaii public schools 2028-2029 calendar with first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, state holidays, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The Hawaii State Department of Education 2028-2029 school calendar lists July 31, 2028 as the first day for students and May 24, 2029 as the last day for students. Fall Break runs October 9-13, 2028, Winter Break runs December 22, 2028 through January 4, 2029, and Spring Break runs March 19-23, 2029. The calendar includes 180 student days, 189 teacher days, state holidays, Election Day, a January 5 teacher workday, and an institute day window during October 23-27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hawaii public school start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Hawaii public school students start the 2028-2029 school year on Monday, July 31, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Fall Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 9 through Friday, October 13, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Winter Break in 2028-2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Friday, December 22, 2028 through Thursday, January 4, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Spring Break in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 19 through Friday, March 23, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Hawaii public schools in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Thursday, May 24, 2029.
